t Veld
is a village in the
Dutch
province of
North Holland
. It is a part of the municipality of
Hollands Kroon
, and lies about 8 km north of
Heerhugowaard
.
The village was first mentioned between 1839 and 1859 as "'t Veld", and means "the field".
